role: Senior AI Engineer owning the candidate-JD matching stack on a founding team at Redrob AI
role_description: The Senior AI Engineer will own the intelligence layer of Redrob's product, including ranking, retrieval, and matching systems. The role requires deep technical depth in modern ML systems and a scrappy product-engineering attitude. The ideal candidate will have production experience with embeddings-based retrieval systems, vector databases, and strong Python skills.
company_description: Redrob AI is a Series A AI-native talent intelligence platform that has raised its round and is building a new AI Engineering org from scratch. The company is looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join its founding team and drive the long-term architecture of its candidate-JD matching system.
what_you_will_do: As a Senior AI Engineer at Redrob AI, you will own the intelligence layer of the company's product, including ranking, retrieval, and matching systems. Your first 90 days will involve auditing the current system, identifying areas for improvement, and shipping a v2 ranking system that demonstrably improves recruiter-engagement metrics. You will also set up evaluation infrastructure, including offline benchmarks, online A/B testing, and recruiter-feedback loops. Beyond that, you will drive the long-term architecture of the candidate-JD matching system, mentor the next round of hires, and work closely with the recruiter-experience PM to build new features.
candidate_work: Own the intelligence layer of Redrob's product, including ranking, retrieval, and matching systems
Audit the current system and identify areas for improvement
Ship a v2 ranking system that demonstrably improves recruiter-engagement metrics
Set up evaluation infrastructure, including offline benchmarks, online A/B testing, and recruiter-feedback loops
Drive the long-term architecture of the candidate-JD matching system
Mentor the next round of hires
Work closely with the recruiter-experience PM to build new features
donts: Candidates with only academic/research experience and no shipped production systems
Pure consulting or IT-services background with no product ownership
Candidates who require full technical specs before working — this role demands autonomy
Title-chasers who switch companies every 1.5 years for title upgrades
Framework enthusiasts who focus on frameworks rather than systems
People who have only worked at consulting firms with no product-company experience
People whose primary expertise is computer vision, speech, or robotics without significant NLP/IR exposure
